name: pr-20261013-final-audit
command:
import collections, hashlib, json, posixpath, re, subprocess
root="/Users/huaodong/workspace/_worktrees/pr-ready-20261013"
def git(*args): return subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", root, *args])
tree=git("write-tree").decode().strip()
files=set(git("ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", "-z", tree).decode().split("\0"))
pr="docs/acceptance/consolidation-20261011/PR.md"
text=git("show", ":"+pr).decode()
links=[]
for dest in re.findall(r"\]\(([^\s()]+)\)", text):
    if re.match(r"^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:", dest): continue
    resolved=posixpath.normpath(posixpath.join(posixpath.dirname(pr), dest.split("#")[0]))
    assert resolved in files or any(p.startswith(resolved+"/") for p in files), resolved
    links.append(resolved)
print("PR local links tracked and resolvable:", len(links))
source=git("diff", "1bce260", tree, "--", "apps/desktop/src", "packages/protocol/src", "e2e")
digest=hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest()
assert digest=="5d67dae7263711cc37eb6a6f7e6a7d79ea49dbd0a74bc68686cac9b29a386bc9"
print("Tested product/test bytes unchanged:", digest)
subprocess.run(["git", "-C", root, "diff", "--exit-code", "origin/main", tree, "--", "tests/vertical-slice", "fixtures/vertical-slice", "docs/acceptance/toolchain/package.json", "docs/acceptance/toolchain/package-lock.json", "package-lock.json", "pnpm-lock.yaml"], check=True)
print("Frozen VS001 and dependency lock inputs unchanged from origin/main")
check=subprocess.run(["git", "-C", root, "diff", "origin/main", tree, "--check"], capture_output=True, text=True)
warning_paths=sorted(set(match.group(1).strip(chr(34)) for match in re.finditer(r"^(.+):\d+: (?:trailing whitespace|new blank line at EOF|space before tab in indent)", check.stdout, re.M)))
assert check.returncode in [0,2], check.returncode
assert all(p.startswith("docs/") for p in warning_paths), warning_paths
print("Full PR whitespace check exit:", check.returncode, "warning files:", len(warning_paths), "all confined to docs evidence/receipts")
for p in warning_paths:
    if "/pr-20261013-" in p: print("Current raw receipt whitespace:",p)
changed=set(git("diff", "--name-only", "-z", "origin/main", tree).decode().split("\0"))
sizes=[]
for item in git("ls-tree", "-rlz", tree).split(b"\0"):
    if not item: continue
    meta, raw=item.split(b"\t",1)
    mode,kind,sha,size=meta.split()
    name=raw.decode()
    if name in changed and kind==b"blob": sizes.append((int(size),name))
assert all(size < 50*1024*1024 for size,_ in sizes)
assert not [name for _,name in sizes if any(part in [".env", ".ssh", ".aws", "__pycache__", "node_modules"] for part in name.split("/")) or name.endswith((".pyc", ".pem", ".p12", ".pfx"))]
print("Changed blobs:",len(sizes),"largest:",max(sizes),"no private/cache path names")
inventory=json.loads(git("show", "917f375:docs/acceptance/consolidation-20261011/source-inventory.json"))
original={s["source_path"]:s["head"] for s in inventory["sources"]}
original.update({"/private/tmp/wsl-consolidate-review-20261011":"917f3755865c5c90e1d1bcee73bc1dfa8ebbebe4","/Users/huaodong/workspace/_worktrees/status-surface-20261011":"1bce260678c5d60e6889a093e0c523c333019fca","/Users/huaodong/workspace/_worktrees/wsl-edu-20261012":"ea3bad9e6602ccec3484cc55b247bae5815975b4","/Users/huaodong/workspace/_worktrees/wsl-edu-source-20261012":"be3a9f66cf1d02c934650de00dd3af64e20a5971"})
current={}
for block in git("worktree", "list", "--porcelain").decode().strip().split("\n\n"):
    fields=dict(line.split(" ",1) if " " in line else (line,"") for line in block.splitlines())
    current[fields["worktree"]]=fields["HEAD"]
assert len(original)==28
assert all(current.get(p)==head for p,head in original.items())
print("Original worktree HEADs unchanged:",len(original),"total worktrees including candidate:",len(current))
print("Staged tree before this audit receipt:",tree)
